idea: On this page, the hi-vis vest every Bellis crew wears becomes the poster's ground: flat safety-yellow and black, blunt statements at full volume, product cut-outs stuck on at a tilt.
storyline: The five jobs, said bluntly, then the company
rhythm: HOLD: the h1 and the action stand at p 0; the five statements land one after another; REST

chapters.label: Opening statement
chapters.concept: The h1 and the action are readable at p 0. As the visitor scrolls the held stage, the five problems insulation solves land one after another, then the payoff. The photograph rises once on load and then stands still.

transitionOut.cause: the next section's ground follows the held stage
